review_notes: I read the whole file (two theorems) and the definitions they depend on. These were cutoffStaircase, hasFDerivAt_cutoffStaircase, shiftedStaircase, contDiff_shiftedStaircase, staircaseCovector and planarGradient (RankOneFilling.lean). The hypotheses 0<h, 0<δ, δ<h/4 are satisfiable, and u and χ are only required to be differentiable at z. The conclusion is a real equation between planarGradient of the cutoff staircase and staircaseCovector. The arguments are in the right order: χ z, θ, u z, then the gradients of u and χ. The coefficient (1-χ+χ·P') multiplies ∇u and (P(u)-u) multiplies ∇χ, which matches hasFDerivAt_cutoffStaircase. The second theorem is a genuine ContDiffOn statement with ContDiffOn hypotheses. No vacuity, trivialising definition, or missing condition. One small point: h and δ are implicit and recoverable from hh, hδ and hδh. That is stylistic and outside this rubric.
